name: gout-execution-receipts-across-terminal-bd4a
instr:
gout cannot currently expose immutable execution receipts for ordinary, retry, curl, and benchmark operations. Add observation without changing behavior when none is configured.

The public package `github.com/guonaihong/gout/execution` must provide `ExecutionID`, `EventKind`, `Outcome`, `Event`, `AttemptReceipt`, `Receipt`, `ExecutionObserver`, and `ObserverError`. Configure observation through `WithExecutionObserver` and `NewWithOpt` from `github.com/guonaihong/gout`, `DataFlow.ObserveExecution` from `github.com/guonaihong/gout/dataflow`, and `Report.Receipt` from `github.com/guonaihong/gout/bench`.

Each terminal operation must invoke its observer exactly once with a finalized snapshot. Identities must be nonempty, parent relationships correct, event sequences contiguous from 1, and the last event the sole terminal event. Record only lifecycle boundaries reached, ordered through construction, transport, response binding, validation, and outcome.

Retry receipts must preserve attempt order, distinct identities, actual regeneration and callback decisions. Cancellation while waiting after regeneration must retain the attempt identity, publish no later attempt, and end with one cancellation outcome. Curl receipts must distinguish rendering from sending and claim no transport or binding for generation-only work.

Benchmark receipts must contain one child per completed request, sorted by child identifier. Parentage and outcome totals must match the existing report supplied to `G
